name: bridge-tagger
description: Classify cybersecurity controls and techniques into Federated Memory Taxonomy bridge tags

input.text: Implement redundant power supplies and automatic failover to backup generators for critical server infrastructure.
Adversaries inject malicious firmware into UEFI boot sequences to maintain persistent access and modify system behavior undetected.
Multi-factor authentication using hardware tokens ensures only authorized personnel access classified systems.
SQL injection in the login form allows attackers to bypass authentication and extract the entire user database.
Network traffic is encrypted using steganographic techniques to hide command-and-control communications within normal HTTPS traffic.
Calibrate the radar cross-section measurement equipment monthly and verify accuracy against known reference targets.
The single Ethernet link between the control room and the reactor monitoring system has no redundant path.

cases.notes: Single point of failure, no redundancy

input.text: Certificate-pinned mutual TLS authenticates both client and server, while automated backup restores service within 30 seconds of failure.
